About the event

How it works.

We’re planning an event where teams of 2–5 choose a project, build a prototype and give a short demo. It’s a chance to work with students outside your usual classes.

30–60 students

2–5per team

60 students

Refract is awaiting school approval. The date and final capacity are still to be confirmed.

Project ideas

What could you build?

The proposal covers software, engineering, science and projects that combine them. A few starting points:

Software & AI

Build an app, try a small model, or automate something you usually do by hand.

Robotics & hardware

Make a robot, work with sensors, or build a physical prototype.

Science & data

Use a dataset or a simulation to investigate a question.

Something else

Combine subjects in one project. These examples are just a starting point.

FAQ

Questions?

What is Refract?+

A student-led hackathon being planned at PRISMS. You’d work in a small team on a project, then give a short demo and get feedback.

Who can participate?+

Current PRISMS students. We’re planning for 30–60 participants in teams of 2–5, with final capacity to be agreed with the school.

Does my project have to be software?+

No. Hardware, robotics, scientific computing and data projects are also part of the proposal.

When and where will it happen?+

PRISMS campus is the proposed venue. The date and length of the event are still being worked out with the school.

Are there prizes?+

The target is $3,000+ in prizes, provided enough sponsorship is secured and the school approves. No prizes have been confirmed yet.

How do I sign up?+

Registration isn’t open yet. The date and sign-up process still need school approval.

How will the event be supervised?+

The student organizers would work with PRISMS faculty on supervision, room access, lab safety and event hours. Those arrangements are still to be agreed.
